name: intelliprompter
description: Speak through a checklist; Jev (TypeSafe AI) checks items off from your live transcript.

scripts.serve: if [ -f .server.pid ] && kill -0 "$(cat .server.pid)" 2>/dev/null; then echo "Already running: http://localhost:${PORT:-9070}"; else nohup node --env-file-if-exists=.env server.js > server.log 2>&1 & echo $! > .server.pid; sleep 1; cat server.log; fi
scripts.stop: if [ -f .server.pid ] && kill "$(cat .server.pid)" 2>/dev/null; then rm .server.pid; echo Stopped; else rm -f .server.pid; echo 'Not running'; fi
